q1_issues.issue: The address is typed (Member addr_54346_avenida_velasco address) with a kind noun the text never supplies, and its symbol carries an invented addr_ prefix rather than being built from the name alone.

(Ongoing sk_request_1) has no licensed progressive marker — a reduced-relative participle ('a person requesting assistance') is none of the four markers the instruction set enumerates as the only sources of Ongoing.

(Experiencer sk_regard_1 sk_assistance_1) demotes the subject of a stative transitive ('regarding' in its concern sense), which the role rules keep as Agent unless the verb is possession or stative psych/perception.
The bare non-specific mass object 'assistance' is given a witness sk_assistance_1 plus a class atom instead of the bare class symbol the instruction set reserves for non-specific/generic objects.

q2_gaps: Plain simultaneity 'when' joining two simple-past clauses: the connective rules name Before/During as the canonical forms for after/before/during/while but assign none to bare 'when', so the temporal link between the incident beginning and the deputies receiving the call is simply lost.

Episodic bare-plural subject ('Deputies said …'): bare plurals are routed to generic Implication rules or kind-level Inheritance, and no route is stated for a bare plural naming specific participants in a one-off past event (the parse defaults to a group witness).
notes: Sealing is handled well: the definite 'the incident' and the named address project to top level while the indefinite call, person and disturbance stay inside the say-complement. phone_call and domestic_disturbance get correct genus atoms with no noun-modifier genus exposed.
